description: This is an HTML source file that implements the front-end interface for a Database Viewer application, including UI layout, styling, and client-side scripting for interacting with a backend API to list databases, tables, and display table data dynamically.
external_files: fetch API (built-in), CSS (embedded), possibly external scripts or styles if linked externally

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches list of databases from API and populates the database list UI.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the list of databases by re-fetching from the API and resetting UI states.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Handles expansion/collapse of database entries to show associated tables.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches and displays tables for a selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches and renders data from a selected table, displaying in a tabular format.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Generates HTML to display table data with headers and rows, including handling wide content and nested objects.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Creates individual table cell content, handling nulls, objects, long strings, and normal values.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses cell content to show full data or truncate with ellipsis.

search-terms: HTML + CSS layout for database UI
